data.raw_text:
MAG-MASK ‘PAG LALABAS! 😷

A thick cloud of polluted smoke hangs over the nation’s capital as the ongoing fire at the Navotas sanitary landfill continues to degrade air quality across Metro Manila.

In an aerial image taken on April 27, 2026, dense haze was seen spreading over neighborhoods and major thoroughfares, reducing visibility and raising health risks for residents.

In response, the Department of Environment and Natural Resources has directed all sanitary landfill operators to submit contingency measures for emergency situations, nearly two weeks after the blaze began at the Navotas facility.

📸 The STAR/Edd Gumban
